modules.title: Introduction to Government and Leadership
modules.html:
The arms of government and the qualities of good leadership. This section covers introduction to government and leadership.

Key points

  • A system of government where the law is supreme over everyone, including the rulers, is the _____. — Rule of Law.
  • The administrative machinery used by the government to implement its policies is the _____. — Public service.
  • A society that is independent of government control and consists of NGOs and community groups is _____. — Civil society.
  • Constitutionalism means that the government should be _____. — Subject to the provisions of the constitution.
  • The principle where the three organs of government operate separately to prevent tyranny is _____. — Separation of Powers.

Worked examples

Q: A system of government where the law is supreme over everyone, including the rulers, is the _____.
A: Rule of Law — The Rule of Law, as popularized by A.V. Dicey, implies that no one is above the law and everyone is subject to it equally.

Q: The administrative machinery used by the government to implement its policies is the _____.
A: Public service — The public service (or civil service) consists of employees who carry out the day-to-day functions of the government and implement its policies.

examples.q: A system of government where the law is supreme over everyone, including the rulers, is the _____.
The administrative machinery used by the government to implement its policies is the _____.

quiz.q: A system of government where the law is supreme over everyone, including the rulers, is the _____.
quiz.solution: The Rule of Law, as popularized by A.V. Dicey, implies that no one is above the law and everyone is subject to it equally.

quiz.q: The administrative machinery used by the government to implement its policies is the _____.
quiz.solution: The public service (or civil service) consists of employees who carry out the day-to-day functions of the government and implement its policies.

quiz.q: A society that is independent of government control and consists of NGOs and community groups is _____.
quiz.solution: Civil society refers to the 'third sector' of society, distinct from government and business, and including the family and the private sphere.

quiz.q: Constitutionalism means that the government should be _____.
options: Subject to the provisions of the constitution
quiz.solution: Constitutionalism is the principle that government power should be limited by a constitution to prevent arbitrary rule.

quiz.q: The principle where the three organs of government operate separately to prevent tyranny is _____.
quiz.solution: Separation of powers ensures that the Legislature, Executive, and Judiciary have distinct functions and powers to prevent the concentration of power.

quiz.q: Which organ of government is responsible for interpreting laws?
quiz.solution: The Judiciary is the arm of government that interprets the law and adjudicates disputes in courts.

quiz.q: The administrative machinery of government through which policies are implemented is the _____.
quiz.solution: The Civil Service (Public Service) consists of career officials who implement the programs and policies of the government of the day.

quiz.q: A society that is independent of government and includes NGOs and community groups is called _____.
quiz.solution: Civil society consists of non-governmental organizations and institutions that manifest the interests and will of citizens.
